title: Kremlin: invitation for European envoys to Moscow still open; rejects Johnson troop idea
detail: Kremlin adviser Yury Ushakov said European countries have not declined Moscow's invitation to send envoys for talks on Ukraine and that it remains open. Spokesman Dmitry Peskov called a proposal by former UK PM Boris Johnson for a token Western troop deployment in Ukraine 'unacceptable', and declined to comment on reports of 470,000-700,000 Russian soldiers dead, saying only the defence ministry can release casualty figures. Reported via a single live blog (France 24).

title: Two Libyan naval officers die after Ukrainian-claimed sea drone attack near Benghazi
detail: An eastern Libyan official said two Libyan naval officers died of wounds from the Ukrainian-claimed sea drone attack on Russian vessels near Benghazi (Nov 22). Libya's General Command vowed retaliation 'at the appropriate time and place'; Ukrainian FM Andrii Sybiha called the strikes legitimate self-defence despite criticism from the Tripoli government. Single-source report (France 24); follow-up to the Nov 22 event.
